findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: There was a severely dented can of campbell’s soup on a shelf in the grocery section. The dents were on the side seam of the can and there was a point at the top seam. The can was pulled from the shelf to correct the violation. Ensure that packaging of food items are in dent free condition.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed a bottle of glass cleaner stored on a shelf directly above the triple sink. Discussed with PIC and the bottle was removed. Ensure that toxic chemicals are stored in a manner that prevents contamination of clean dishes.
findings.citation_text: 7-201.11 Separation. Poisonous or toxic materials shall be stored so they can not contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles by: (A) Separating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS by spacing or partitioning; and (B) Locating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS in an area that is not above FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE or SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Observed stagnant waste water inside of the mop sink in the back-stock area. The person-in-charge (PIC) mentioned that a work order will be placed to have the sink serviced so that waste water is able to drain properly. Stagnant waste water can attract unwanted pest and insects.  Ensure that waste water is never stagnant and is able to drain in an appropriate sanitary manner.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.15 Flushing a Waste Retention Tank. A tank for liquid waste retention shall be thoroughly flushed and drained in a sanitary manner during the servicing operation.
